name: uname
summary: Prints information about the kernel and the machine.
description: Gives the kernel name (Linux), its version, the machine name and the processor architecture. To find out the distribution (Ubuntu, Debian…), look at /etc/os-release or lsb_release -a instead.

examples.explanation: All the information on one line.
examples.output: Linux laptop 6.8.0-45-generic #45-Ubuntu SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux

examples.explanation: The architecture, useful for choosing which binary to download.
